_comment: Symphony Playing Exam #2, posted by the Post Assignment workflow.
The piece is Tchaikovsky's NUTCRACKER — No. 14 is the Pas de deux and
No. 15 the Final Waltz, which is what the movement numbers below are.
An earlier draft of the handout said The Sleeping Beauty; it has neither
of those movements and is in no Hub repertoire list. Do not 'correct'
`id` is a stable doc id so re-running this file updates the same exam
rather than posting a second one. googleDriveFolderId is deliberately
absent: that folder is created by the Connect Google Drive button in the
app, which needs the director's own Google sign-in. Video submissions
work without it (they land in Firebase Storage either way).
title: Symphony Playing Exam #2
description:
This playing exam is due **Wednesday, September 23rd, by the end of the day.** Late exams cannot be submitted or accepted through any other method except this hub.

State your name and grade level at the beginning of your video. Points will be deducted if this is not done. Your video must show the entire playing area and cannot be edited with cuts.

__Violin 1__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Coda (No. 15): measure 35 through the end of the coda.

__Violin 2__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Coda (No. 15): measure 50 through the end of the coda.

__Viola__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Final Waltz (No. 15): beginning through the downbeat of measure 65.

__Cello__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Pas de Deux (No. 14): measures 4–25.

__Bass__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Coda (No. 15): measure 50 through the end of the coda.

__Flute__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Coda (No. 15): measure 35 through the end of the coda. All play Flute 1.

__Oboe__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Pas de Deux (No. 14): pickup to measure 26 through measure 67.

__Clarinet__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Pas de Deux (No. 14): measures 47–67. All play Clarinet 1.

__Bassoon__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Final Waltz (No. 15): measures 49–95. Both play Bassoon 1.

__Piano/Celesta__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Final Waltz (No. 15): measures 128–144.

__Percussion__
Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Coda (No. 14): measure 57 through the end of the coda. Cymbal part.

__Horn__
Gershwin, *Rhapsody in Blue*: Rehearsal 34 through Rehearsal 37.

__Trumpet__
Delibes, *Sylvia*, Cortège de Bacchus: Letter O to the end. All play Cornet 1.

__Tenor Trombone__
Gershwin, *Rhapsody in Blue*: Rehearsal 34 through Rehearsal 37. Trombone 1 part.

__Bass Trombone/Tuba__
Gershwin, *Rhapsody in Blue*: Rehearsal 36 through Rehearsal 37.

__Tenor Saxophone__
Gershwin, *Rhapsody in Blue*: pickup to Rehearsal 12 through Rehearsal 18.

__Banjo/Guitar__
Gershwin, *Rhapsody in Blue*: Rehearsal 37 through the end.

__Harp__
Massenet, *Cendrillon*, Marche des Princesses: Rehearsal 333–335.
